title: Tritone
summary: TRI'TONE, noun [Latin tres and tonus.] In music, a false concord, consisting of three tones, two major and one minor tone, or of two tones and two semitones; a dissonant interval.

inlines.v: TRI'TONE, noun [Latin tres and tonus.] In music, a false concord, consisting of three tones, two major and one minor tone, or of two tones and two semitones; a dissonant interval.
